items.question: How do I book and pay?
items.answer: Just click the button for whatever offer fits you best. You'll complete an intake form and get immediate access to scheduling and next steps.

items.question: Can I upgrade later if I want more support?
items.answer: Yes — you can move from the 21-Day Intensive to the Fine Tune 90-Day Support at any point. We'll credit your investment toward the upgrade.

items.question: What if I have food allergies or dietary restrictions?
items.answer: All protocols are built around your specific dietary needs and restrictions. Your intake form collects this detail before our first session.

items.question: Do I need to track calories or macros?
items.answer: No. We don't focus on calorie counting. Our approach centers on food quality, symptom patterns, and therapeutic nutrition — not numbers.

items.question: Is this for weight loss?
items.answer: It can support healthy weight change as a natural outcome, but it's not a weight-loss program. The focus is on root-cause patterns and how your body feels and functions.

content.heading: Not sure where to begin?
bodyParagraphs: Choosing the right kind of support for your health journey is a big deal and you don't want to be rushed. If you're leaning toward the Fine Tune 90-Day Support but still have questions (or a little hesitation), let's talk it out.
Schedule a Connection Call and we'll make sure it's the right fit, together.
